Jules (AE): Heads up — Dan from Meridian Health wants an air-gapped POC. Primary asks: tamper-evident courier, signed SBOM, monthly security deltas, rollback guarantees, and proof of bundle provenance for auditors.

Kofi (SE): Noted. Technical constraints/questions: do they accept USB delivery with sealed envelope photos? Also, are they ok with a single curated model to keep bundle small?

Dan (Customer): USB + photo COA is our preference. Single curated model is fine. Procurement also requires a signed checksum and signature file and a reproducible-build attestation.

Mira (Product Ops): We can assemble a "poc-min" bundle (strip telemetry, remove optional CLIs) — typical full bundle 20–25GB, target poc-min ~5–7GB depending on model precision.

Sam (Security): For airgap we require: detached signature, SBOM (CycloneDX), build-attestation with toolchain hashes, and a chain-of-custody template for courier. Verification snippet we expect customers to run: 

```
sha256sum -c redwood-poc.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood.pub -signature redwood-poc.sig redwood-poc.sha256
```

Pri (Legal): Commercial note: monthly deltas require a maintenance SOW that defines patch windows and rollback support. Dan — will your team accept a retainer for emergency hotfixes with a capped annual spend?

Dan (Customer): Yes to retainer + cap, but we need explicit SLA for initial advisory (we want 72h) and final fix timeline (30 days for critical). Also need escrow language for emergency code access if Redwood cannot respond in a crisis.

Jules (AE): We'll propose retainer + capped T&M and include an escrow carve-out for critical hotfixes.

Kofi (SE): On deltas/rollbacks: we support signed binary deltas for runtime/security patches but they cannot change model quantization or runtime ABI. A quantization change = full bundle. Rollback path: single-step rollback to previous bundle only — customers must retain previous bundle as rollback artifact.

Dan (Customer): That's acceptable but we need the rollback drill in the dry-run. Also require SBOM for all third-party libs.

Mira (Product Ops): SBOM + attestation generation is automated. If we use curated runtime + model, artifacts ready in 48–72 hours. If custom quantization requested, add 3–5 business days.

Sam (Security): Vulnerability timeline: initial advisory within 48–72 hours for critical issues, mitigation guidance in 5 business days, and a target remediation in 30 days when feasible. We'll note exceptions for third-party upstream libs.

Kofi (SE): HSM question: do you plan to use USB tokens or network HSM? USB tokens (PKCS#11) we can support for POC; will need vendor + firmware for pre-validation. Offline key import flow will be in the runbook.

Dan (Customer): We'll provide a Yubikey-like USB token for the POC and vendor details.

ops-bot: poc-artifact-job queued for bundle=poc-min-1717000001, status=queued

Jules (AE): Action items: 1) Kofi/Mira: build poc-min bundle (target 6GB) + SBOM + attestation + delta manifest template; 2) Sam: draft airgap security questionnaire answers + vuln SLA; 3) Pri: SOW draft with retainer, cap, and escrow clause; 4) Dan: courier COA requirements + USB token vendor info.

Kofi (SE): I'll start the build as quantization-free to allow future deltas. ETA artifacts: 3 business days.

Dan (Customer): Please include a 60min dry-run checklist and a rollback rehearsal.

Jules (AE): Will do — tentatively schedule dry-run the week after artifacts are ready. I'll follow up with calendar options. :white_check_mark:
